value: Memorial image generation workflow: before creating or replacing images for /memorials boards, first study existing high-quality masters from photo-stock, future-world, and imagination. Analyze composition, Chinese title hierarchy, black-gold/deep-blue palette, real scene treatment, UI information panels, and detail density. For each new theme, write an individual prompt based on its content, not one batch template. Generate bitmap images, screen/select them, place final files in public/memorials/generated/, avoid programmatic geometry or crude collage as final images, then inspect the online page screenshot to confirm the new cards match old image quality before deploying.

zerozero-reader: avoid running npm run build while Next dev server is serving a browser verification session; both touch .next and can cause temporary 404/static chunk misses. For UI verification, run build first, then restart npm run dev before Playwright checks.
